_readme: Feed for the Legal register page. Each item: id (matches a built-in id to update it, or a new id to add one), jur (EG|EU), area, title_en, title_ar, ref, note_en, note_ar, change_en, change_ar, date (YYYY-MM-DD), url (optional https link). Edit this file and host it next to the platform; devices pick it up when online. It is a pointer list, not legal advice.
